label: Every joint limit, threshold and blend below is DN5 illustrative - needs certified-clinician review (CR-09, CR-36).

V1.before: Shoulder 170 -> 190 deg sweeps from the hanging arm: output jumped 120 deg (flexion) and 110 deg (abduction) at 180.25 deg; twist range widened to +-180 deg above 150 deg elevation.
V1.rootCause: The swing-twist split used the hanging-arm reference, whose 180 deg wrap is the flexion/abduction HARD value; the projection was nearest in the chart, which wraps there.
fix: Shoulder swing-twist split about the anterior reference (doc 12 section 2.4): singularity posterior, 30 deg beyond the extension stop.
Swing limit kept in clinical hanging-arm terms (constant rotation to that limit chart).

Clamp projects the child axis to the nearest allowed direction on the sphere (coarse 32 points per quarter plus golden refinement), corrects by the shortest rotation, then clamps the twist about the limb at that direction.

Humeral rotation read from a swing-dependent neutral: hanging-arm neutral up to 120 deg elevation (readings identical to the hanging chart there), blended (smoothstep) to one overhead neutral halfway between the flexion and abduction paths by 180 deg (ASSUMED, DN5). IR 70 / ER 90 at every elevation; no widening.
Excess below 1e-9 rad is rounding (re-clamping a clamped rotation changes nothing).

after.shoulderOverhead170to190: 0 jumps; max output step 0.250 deg (flexion, scapular plane) and 0.566 deg (abduction) for 0.25 deg input steps; held within 1 deg of 180 deg elevation; fake rig and live rig (Chrome and WebKit, both sizes)

after.overheadReadings: pure flexion overhead reads IR -90 (at the ER 90 bound); pure abduction overhead reads IR +90 (clamped by 20 deg toward ER)

V2.before: SupportSurface.sd measured to the nearest face of 75 mm pads: calves 51.8 mm below the leg-pad tops read 23.2 mm, direction down; supportMaxMm 37.5 mm.
fix: Resting surfaces (pads, arm boards, head rest) have no bottom face: inside a footprint, down to the bottom of the table-top stack, sd = -(nearest of the depth below the top and the four side distances), with that face's normal; never down.
depthBelowTop(p): plain depth below the highest resting top (the sinking reading).
skinPenetration reports both (support*, belowTop*), per support, the deepest vertex, downward exits and side exits.
